watches.name: FUSION
watches.description: Introducing Pre order now. Estimated shipping in November. First come, first served. LIMITED TO 30 UNITS An experimental piece combining familiar elements into something entirely new. The Fusion Collection reimagines the signature design language of Galvin Watch Company through a bold and contemporary lens. Featuring a sculpted tonneau-shaped case, an exposed mechanical heart, and an intricate guilloché-style dial, Fusion blurs the line between traditional watchmaking and modern design experimentation. At the centre of the watch is a striking red-to-black fumé gradient dial, revealing a subtle glimpse of the Miyota 9039 automatic movement beneath. The hypnotic guilloché-style pattern creates depth and movement across the dial, shifting beautifully in changing light. The dial is complemented by Swiss Super-LumiNova C3 accents, enhancing visibility while adding a subtle glow after dark. Encased in black DLC-coated 316L stainless steel, Fusion is both elegant and unapologetically bold. Designed by industry-accredited watchmaker Susan Galvin, and assembled and tested in our Sydney workshop, the collection continues Galvin Watch Company’s dedication to independent watchmaking and craftsmanship. Rooted in Susan’s Finnish heritage, the tonneau-shaped Suvi platform serves as the foundation for Fusion - an expressive evolution of the collection. Suvi translates to “summer” in Finnish. Available Variations Fusion 1 Blacked-out hands with bold black C3 lume accents Black DLC-plated customised rotor Fusion 2 Stainless steel hands Stainless steel customised rotor Fusion 3 Rose gold-plated hands Rose gold-plated customised rotor Fusion 4 Fully lumed white hands with Swiss Super-LumiNova C3 Black DLC plated customised rotor Specifications Diameter: 33 mm × 40 mm Thickness: 11.15 mm Lug to lug: 46 mm Lug width: 19 mm Crown: 6 mm Black DLC-coated stainless steel 316L case and crown Domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflection coating Exhibition case back with sapphire crystal Miyota 9039 calibre with customised rotor 5 ATM water resistance Assembly & Shipping Each Fusion watch is assembled, regulated and tested in-house in our Sydney workshop by Susan Galvin. Shipping is free worldwide. Please note that international customers outside Australia are responsible for any applicable local taxes, duties and customs fees.

watches.name: Loimu Coal - Special Edition
watches.description: Loimu Coal – Special Edition *** With the Loimu Frozen Salmon sold out, we are proud to introduce a striking new addition to the Special Edition family — Loimu Coal . Limited to just 30 pieces worldwide , this edition features 30 exclusive dials and will not be reproduced. As with all Galvin Watch Company timepieces, each watch is assembled, regulated, and tested in-house in Sydney by Susan. The Dial Loimu Coal features a stunning guilloché-style fumé dial in a deep coal grey tone. The colour transitions from lighter shades at the centre to darker edges, creating remarkable depth and visual movement under changing light. The dial is finished with: Swiss Super-LumiNova C3 hour markers and hands for exceptional low-light legibility. Black electroplated hands and indexes for a bold, modern contrast No date window, resulting in a clean and symmetrical layout Unlike other Loimu variants, the Coal edition is powered by the Miyota 9039 Premium Range calibre , a no-date movement chosen specifically for this design. Bracelet & Strap Options The Loimu Coal Special Edition comes fitted with a stainless steel bracelet. You may also add an additional strap to your order to personalise your watch. THE SPECIFICATIONS: CASE MATERIAL 316L Stainless Steel CASE DIAMETER 38mm CASE THICKNESS 11.6mm LUG TO LUG 45mm LUG WIDTH 19mm HANDS Stainless Steel with Swiss Super-LumiNova C3, black electoplated CROWN Screw-down crown with Swiss Super-LumiNova C3 DIAL Guilloche-style dial with a Swiss Super-LumiNova C3 hour markers (No date window) CRYSTAL Flat Sapphire Crystal with an antireflective coating MOVEMENT Miyota Premium range Calibre 9039 WATER RESISTANCE* 10ATM / 100 meters POWER RESERVE 42h Bracelet Sizes: The bracelet comes in one size; however, it can be adjusted to your preference. If you prefer a strap instead of the bracelet, we can easily arrange that for you. Please contact susan@galvinwatchcompany.com.au with any adjustments. Shipping is free, however you are required to pay your relevant country’s taxes and customs fees (outside of Australia). *Please see a short tutorial of the Loimu crown and the water resistance here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OLvnTnyqLAQ&t=8s

watches.name: YÖ - Limited Edition
watches.description: YÖ* This model may still be available through our authorised stockists: Virage and Island Watch . Limited to 50 units. Designed, assembled, regulated, and tested in-house by founder and watchmaker Susan Galvin. *YÖ is the Finnish word for night. This luminous edition features a fumed turquoise dial with a mesmerizing luminous gradient. The guilloché-style texture is elevated by bold black C3 lume accents on the hands, logo, and crown. The fade effect itself is created using BGW9 Swiss Super-LumiNova. The watch is paired with a black or turquoise FKM rubber strap and a black DLC-coated GWC butterfly clasp. As with all GWC watches, straps are fully interchangeable, allowing you to personalise your YÖ to suit your style. You can add any strap of your choice as an add-on. The YÖ release is limited to just 50 units, with an estimated delivery time of around two weeks. Shipping is free, however you are required to pay your relevant country’s taxes and customs fees (outside of Australia). Specifications: Diameter: 33 mm × 40 mm Thickness: 11.15 mm Lug width: 19 mm Lug-to-lug: 46 mm Crown: 6 mm Domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating Exhibition case back with sapphire crystal Miyota 9039 calibre featuring a black rotor, made exclusively for the YÖ edition Black DLC-coated stainless steel 316L case and crown 5 ATM water resistance

watches.name: GWC Bracelet
watches.description: GWC Bracelet The GWC stainless steel bracelet is designed specifically for the Loimu Collection , including the Loimu Special Edition and Loimu Tuxedo Edition . Crafted from 316L stainless steel with a brushed finish, the bracelet combines durability with a refined aesthetic. It features split pins for easy adjustment and a micro-adjustment clasp for a precise fit. The separate end links ensure a secure connection and reduce gaps between the bracelet and the case, providing both comfort and a seamless look.

watches.name: Loimu Tundra Tuxedo
watches.description: Loimu Tundra Tuxedo Limited to 50 units. Designed, assembled, regulated, and tested in-house by founder and watchmaker Susan Galvin. Introducing the latest evolution in the Loimu series - the Loimu Tundra Tuxedo. This refined timepiece features a lilac guilloché-style dial, complemented by a bold purple outer ring to create the signature "tuxedo" effect. In this edition, we’ve removed the date window to highlight the beauty of the dial and to incorporate the Miyota 9039 Premium Range Calibre - a slim, high-performance movement purpose-built without a date function. The applied round hour markers, along with the handset, are filled with Swiss Super-LumiNova® C3 for outstanding low-light visibility. Each Loimu Tundra Tuxedo is paired with an FKM rubber strap featuring a GWC stainless steel butterfly clasp for a secure and elegant fit. Choose from four strap colours: black, grey, dark navy blue or lilac. Alternatively, this model is fully compatible with our entire range of straps and Loimu bracelet - allowing you to tailor the look to your style. If you prefer a leather or vegan leather strap instead of the FKM strap, we can easily arrange that for you. Email: susan@galvinwatchcompany.com.au for any changes. Shipping is free, however you are required to pay your relevant country’s taxes and customs fees (outside of Australia). -- THE SPECIFICATIONS: CASE MATERIAL 316L Stainless Steel CASE DIAMETER 38mm CASE THICKNESS 11.6mm LUG TO LUG 45mm LUG WIDTH 19mm HANDS Stainless Steel with Swiss Super-LumiNova C3 CROWN Screw-down crown with Swiss Super-LumiNova C3 DIAL Guilloche-style dial with a Swiss Super-LumiNova C3 filled markers. watches.name: Suvi Special Edition
watches.description: Galvin x Special Edition Suvi Special Edition Galvin Watch Company is proud to collaborate with Special Edition to bring you an exclusive version of the Suvi Collection, reimagined for versatility and style. Meticulously deconstructed and reconstructed, this watch is designed to transition seamlessly between work and play. The Special Edition Suvi features a bead-blasted steel case with an elegant rose gold coating. Its translucent smoked acrylic crystal showcases a stunning red-to-black colour gradient and an intricate CNC guilloche pattern, offering a subtle glimpse of the Miyota 9039 movement beneath. But that’s not all—every groove of the guilloche pattern is filled with BGW9 lume, delivering a captivating glow. The domed sapphire crystal with AR coating features lumed numerals and a minute track printed on the underside, enhancing the dial's depth. Fully lumed hands and a luminous ring on the crown complete this radiant design. To complement both your professional and casual looks, each Special Edition Suvi comes with a sleek black alligator strap, custom-made for this edition. This exclusive release is limited to just 30 pieces. Specifications: Diameter 33 mm x 40 mm Thickness 11.15 mm Lug width 19 mm Lug to lug 46 mm Crown 6 mm Domed sapphire crystal with antireflection coating Exhibition case back with a sapphire crystal Miyota 9039 calibre with a customised rotor Stainless steel 316 l 5 ATM water resistant

Galvin Watch Company's third collection, Suvi, features a tonneau shaped case, with a premium range automatic movement. Designed by industry accredited watchmaker, Susan Galvin, the collection pays homage to her Finnish heritage. The Suvi Collection is designed, assembled and tested in our Sydney workshop. The Suvi Collection is inspired by a Finnish summer and it comes with seven colour options. Tanned Suede, Navy Blue, Brown, Black Leather, Electric Blue Suede, Beige Suede, Olive Green Suede, as well as Black and Brown Vegan Leather straps, all feature quick-release spring bars.
